name: BlackHole Engine SDK

compatibilityPolicy.whenNoSdkSpecified: Use the manifest default SDK reference. This should usually point to the latest bundled SDK snapshot.
compatibilityPolicy.compatibilityNote: Project guidance indicates most BlackHole Engine APIs are backward-compatible across SDK updates, but version-sensitive behavior should still be checked against the user's SDK when known.

notes: Each reference entry is a local snapshot for one SDK release.
When adding a new SDK reference, append it to references and update defaultSdkVersion only when it should become the default lookup target.
